format: Every Competition OS event: independent verification of paper-ballot transcription
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not a body rule): every paper ballot version needs verification by a different authorized person against the paper original before the round can lock, calculate, approve or publish; discrepancy is terminal for that version and goes to the OD-11 judge-confirmed process; reports show ids, counts and codes only; retention checklist is advisory.
interpretation_notes: Applies to NDCA, UCWDC, WSDC, Studio and Custom events alike; stricter than any body text supplied for UCWDC/Studio. Owner decision OD-12. Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
decision_refs: OD-12 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A; retrospective audit PR #795)
